name: Compute Cluster S66: Adaptive Stops & Support/Resistance
description: Tests: chande_kroll_stop(p_period, q_period, multiplier), pivot_point_sr(). Trailing stops, S/R levels, trend direction from stop relationship.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S66: Adaptive Stops & S/R Levels
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === CHANDE KROLL STOP ===
ck = chande_kroll_stop(p_period=10, q_period=20, multiplier=3.0)(high, low, close)
long_stop = ck.long_stop
short_stop = ck.short_stop

# === TREND DIRECTION FROM STOPS ===
uptrend = long_stop > short_stop

# === PIVOT POINT S/R ===
pp = pivot_point_sr(high, low, close)
pivot = pp.pivot
r1 = pp.resist_1
s1 = pp.support_1
r2 = pp.resist_2
s2 = pp.support_2

# === STOP HIT DETECTION ===
exit_long = close < long_stop

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Chande Kroll Stops',
    category='Stops',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Long Stop', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Short Stop', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(long_stop, short_stop))

xy_lines(
    title='Pivot Points',
    category='Support/Resistance',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Pivot', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='R1', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='S1', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(pivot, r1, s1))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Stop Level', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Long Stop Hit'
    )
)(close, long_stop, exit_long)
